WITH input_payload AS (
  SELECT
    $1::text AS phone_number,
    NULLIF($2::text, '')::bigint AS source_number_id,
    NULLIF($3::text, '') AS external_contact_id,
    NULLIF($4::text, '') AS whatsapp_name,
    NULLIF($5::text, '') AS service,
    NULLIF($6::text, '') AS city,
    NULLIF($7::text, '') AS requirement,
    COALESCE($8::boolean, FALSE) AS is_partial,
    NULLIF($9::text, '')::bigint AS conversation_id,
    COALESCE(NULLIF($10::text, '')::jsonb, '{}'::jsonb) AS qualification_context
),
latest_lead AS (
  SELECT
    l.id AS previous_lead_id,
    l.previous_lead_id AS previous_previous_lead_id,
    l.source_number_id AS previous_source_number_id,
    l.external_contact_id AS previous_external_contact_id,
    l.whatsapp_name AS previous_whatsapp_name,
    l.phone_number AS previous_phone_number,
    l.service AS previous_service,
    l.city AS previous_city,
    l.requirement AS previous_requirement,
    l.clickup_task_id AS previous_clickup_task_id,
    l.clickup_task_url AS previous_clickup_task_url,
    ls.code AS previous_lead_status_code,
    l.created_at AS previous_created_at
  FROM leads l
  JOIN lead_statuses ls ON ls.id = l.lead_status_id
  JOIN input_payload ip ON TRUE
  WHERE l.deleted_at IS NULL
    AND l.phone_number = ip.phone_number
    AND ip.source_number_id IS NOT NULL
    AND l.source_number_id = ip.source_number_id
  ORDER BY l.created_at DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  ip.phone_number,
  ip.source_number_id,
  ip.external_contact_id,
  ip.whatsapp_name,
  ip.service,
  ip.city,
  ip.requirement,
  ip.is_partial,
  ip.conversation_id,
  ip.qualification_context,
  ll.previous_lead_id,
  ll.previous_source_number_id,
  ll.previous_external_contact_id,
  ll.previous_whatsapp_name,
  ll.previous_service,
  ll.previous_city,
  ll.previous_requirement,
  ll.previous_lead_status_code,
  ll.previous_created_at
FROM input_payload ip
LEFT JOIN latest_lead ll ON TRUE;

WITH input_payload AS (
  SELECT
    NULLIF($1::text, '')::bigint AS previous_lead_id,
    NULLIF($2::text, '')::bigint AS source_number_id,
    NULLIF($3::text, '') AS external_contact_id,
    NULLIF($4::text, '') AS whatsapp_name,
    $5::text AS phone_number,
    NULLIF($6::text, '') AS service,
    NULLIF($7::text, '') AS city,
    NULLIF($8::text, '') AS requirement,
    $9::text AS lead_status_code,
    $10::boolean AS is_qualified,
    $11::boolean AS is_partial,
    $12::text AS rotation_key,
    NULLIF($13::text, '')::bigint AS conversation_id,
    COALESCE(NULLIF($14::text, '')::jsonb, '{}'::jsonb) AS qualification_context
),
lead_lock AS (
  SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('lead-conversation:' || conversation_id::text, 0))
  FROM input_payload
  WHERE conversation_id IS NOT NULL
),
upserted_lead AS (
  INSERT INTO leads (
    previous_lead_id, source_number_id, source_conversation_id, external_contact_id,
    whatsapp_name, phone_number, service, city, requirement, qualification_context,
    channel, lead_status_id, is_qualified, is_partial, qualified_at
  )
  SELECT
    ip.previous_lead_id, ip.source_number_id, ip.conversation_id, ip.external_contact_id,
    ip.whatsapp_name, ip.phone_number, ip.service, ip.city, ip.requirement,
    ip.qualification_context, 'whatsapp', ls.id, ip.is_qualified, ip.is_partial,
    CASE WHEN ip.is_qualified THEN NOW() ELSE NULL END
  FROM input_payload ip
  JOIN lead_statuses ls ON ls.code = ip.lead_status_code
  CROSS JOIN lead_lock
  WHERE ip.conversation_id IS NOT NULL
  ON CONFLICT (source_conversation_id) WHERE source_conversation_id IS NOT NULL AND deleted_at IS NULL
  DO UPDATE SET updated_at = leads.updated_at
  RETURNING *
),
linked_conversation AS (
  UPDATE conversations c
  SET lead_id = ul.id,
      source_number_id = COALESCE(ul.source_number_id, c.source_number_id),
      updated_at = NOW()
  FROM upserted_lead ul
  WHERE c.id = ul.source_conversation_id
    AND (c.lead_id IS NULL OR c.lead_id = ul.id)
  RETURNING c.id
),
rotation_lock AS (
  SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('seller-rotation:' || rotation_key, 0))
  FROM input_payload
  CROSS JOIN upserted_lead
),
existing_rotation AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT ar.*
  FROM assignment_rotations ar
  JOIN input_payload ip ON ip.rotation_key = ar.rotation_key
  CROSS JOIN rotation_lock
  FOR UPDATE
),
inserted_rotation AS (
  INSERT INTO assignment_rotations (rotation_key, next_seller_id, created_at, updated_at)
  SELECT ip.rotation_key, s.id, NOW(), NOW()
  FROM input_payload ip
  CROSS JOIN rotation_lock
  JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT id FROM sellers
    WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND is_active = TRUE AND NULLIF(clickup_user_id, '') IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY sort_order ASC, id ASC LIMIT 1
  ) s ON TRUE
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM existing_rotation)
  ON CONFLICT (rotation_key) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING *
),
rotation_row AS (
  SELECT * FROM existing_rotation
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM inserted_rotation
),
lead_to_assign AS (
  SELECT ul.*
  FROM upserted_lead ul
  WHERE ul.assigned_seller_id IS NULL
),
selected_seller AS (
  SELECT s.id, s.name, s.whatsapp_number, s.clickup_user_id, s.sort_order,
         rr.id AS rotation_id
  FROM rotation_row rr
  JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT sx.*
    FROM sellers sx
    WHERE sx.deleted_at IS NULL
      AND sx.is_active = TRUE
      AND NULLIF(sx.clickup_user_id, '') IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY
      CASE WHEN sx.id = rr.next_seller_id THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
      CASE WHEN sx.sort_order >= COALESCE((SELECT sort_order FROM sellers WHERE id = rr.next_seller_id), sx.sort_order)
           THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
      sx.sort_order ASC,
      sx.id ASC
    LIMIT 1
  ) s ON TRUE
  CROSS JOIN lead_to_assign
),
next_candidate AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(
    (SELECT s2.id FROM sellers s2 CROSS JOIN selected_seller cur
     WHERE s2.deleted_at IS NULL AND s2.is_active = TRUE
       AND NULLIF(s2.clickup_user_id, '') IS NOT NULL
       AND (s2.sort_order, s2.id) > (cur.sort_order, cur.id)
     ORDER BY s2.sort_order, s2.id LIMIT 1),
    (SELECT s3.id FROM sellers s3
     WHERE s3.deleted_at IS NULL AND s3.is_active = TRUE
       AND NULLIF(s3.clickup_user_id, '') IS NOT NULL
     ORDER BY s3.sort_order, s3.id LIMIT 1)
  ) AS next_seller_id
),
inserted_assignment AS (
  INSERT INTO lead_assignments (
    lead_id, seller_id, assignment_type, assignment_result, reason, rotation_id, idempotency_key
  )
  SELECT lta.id, ss.id, 'automatic', 'assigned', 'round_robin', ss.rotation_id,
         'lead-assignment:' || lta.id::text
  FROM lead_to_assign lta
  JOIN selected_seller ss ON TRUE
  ON CONFLICT (idempotency_key) WHERE idempotency_key IS NOT NULL
  DO UPDATE SET
    seller_id = EXCLUDED.seller_id,
    assignment_result = 'assigned',
    reason = 'round_robin_retry',
    rotation_id = EXCLUDED.rotation_id
  WHERE lead_assignments.assignment_result = 'failed'
  RETURNING *
),
updated_seller AS (
  UPDATE sellers s
  SET last_assigned_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW()
  FROM inserted_assignment ia
  WHERE s.id = ia.seller_id
  RETURNING s.*
),
updated_rotation AS (
  UPDATE assignment_rotations ar
  SET last_seller_id = ia.seller_id,
      next_seller_id = nc.next_seller_id,
      last_assigned_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW()
  FROM inserted_assignment ia
  CROSS JOIN next_candidate nc
  WHERE ar.id = ia.rotation_id
  RETURNING ar.*
),
updated_lead AS (
  UPDATE leads l
  SET assigned_seller_id = ia.seller_id,
      assigned_at = COALESCE(l.assigned_at, NOW()),
      lead_status_id = ls.id,
      updated_at = NOW()
  FROM inserted_assignment ia
  JOIN lead_statuses ls ON ls.code = 'assigned'
  WHERE l.id = ia.lead_id
  RETURNING l.*
),
inserted_failure AS (
  INSERT INTO lead_assignments (
    lead_id, seller_id, assignment_type, assignment_result, reason, rotation_id, idempotency_key
  )
  SELECT lta.id, NULL, 'automatic', 'failed', 'no_notifiable_seller', rr.id,
         'lead-assignment:' || lta.id::text
  FROM lead_to_assign lta
  LEFT JOIN rotation_row rr ON TRUE
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM selected_seller)
  ON CONFLICT (idempotency_key) WHERE idempotency_key IS NOT NULL DO NOTHING
  RETURNING *
)
SELECT
  ul.id AS lead_id,
  ul.phone_number,
  ul.whatsapp_name,
  ul.service,
  ul.city,
  ul.requirement,
  ul.source_conversation_id AS conversation_id,
  COALESCE(updated_lead.assigned_seller_id, ul.assigned_seller_id) AS assigned_seller_id,
  seller.name AS seller_name,
  seller.whatsapp_number AS seller_whatsapp_number,
  seller.clickup_user_id,
  CASE WHEN COALESCE(updated_lead.assigned_seller_id, ul.assigned_seller_id) IS NOT NULL
       THEN 'assigned' ELSE 'failed' END AS assignment_result,
  (SELECT next_seller_id FROM updated_rotation LIMIT 1) AS next_seller_id
FROM upserted_lead ul
LEFT JOIN updated_lead ON updated_lead.id = ul.id
LEFT JOIN sellers seller ON seller.id = COALESCE(updated_lead.assigned_seller_id, ul.assigned_seller_id)
LEFT JOIN inserted_failure ON TRUE;

WITH input_payload AS (
  SELECT $1::bigint AS lead_id
),
lead_lock AS (
  SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('lead-finalize:' || lead_id::text, 0))
  FROM input_payload
),
pending_assignment AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT la.*
  FROM lead_assignments la
  JOIN input_payload ip ON ip.lead_id = la.lead_id
  CROSS JOIN lead_lock
  WHERE la.assignment_result = 'assigned'
    AND la.rotation_applied_at IS NULL
  ORDER BY la.created_at DESC, la.id DESC
  LIMIT 1
  FOR UPDATE
),
rotation_lock AS (
  SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('seller-rotation:' || ar.rotation_key, 0))
  FROM pending_assignment pa
  JOIN assignment_rotations ar ON ar.id = pa.rotation_id
),
locked_rotation AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT ar.*
  FROM assignment_rotations ar
  JOIN pending_assignment pa ON pa.rotation_id = ar.id
  CROSS JOIN rotation_lock
  FOR UPDATE
),
next_candidate AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(
    (SELECT s2.id FROM sellers s2 JOIN pending_assignment pa ON TRUE JOIN sellers cur ON cur.id = pa.seller_id
     WHERE s2.deleted_at IS NULL AND s2.is_active = TRUE
       AND NULLIF(s2.clickup_user_id, '') IS NOT NULL
       AND (s2.sort_order, s2.id) > (cur.sort_order, cur.id)
     ORDER BY s2.sort_order, s2.id LIMIT 1),
    (SELECT s3.id FROM sellers s3
     WHERE s3.deleted_at IS NULL AND s3.is_active = TRUE
       AND NULLIF(s3.clickup_user_id, '') IS NOT NULL
     ORDER BY s3.sort_order, s3.id LIMIT 1)
  ) AS next_seller_id
),
updated_rotation AS (
  UPDATE assignment_rotations ar
  SET last_seller_id = pa.seller_id,
      next_seller_id = nc.next_seller_id,
      last_assigned_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW()
  FROM pending_assignment pa
  CROSS JOIN next_candidate nc
  WHERE ar.id = pa.rotation_id
  RETURNING ar.id
),
marked_assignment AS (
  UPDATE lead_assignments la
  SET rotation_applied_at = NOW()
  FROM pending_assignment pa
  CROSS JOIN updated_rotation ur
  WHERE la.id = pa.id
  RETURNING la.*
),
updated_seller AS (
  UPDATE sellers s
  SET last_assigned_at = COALESCE(s.last_assigned_at, NOW()), updated_at = NOW()
  FROM marked_assignment ma
  WHERE s.id = ma.seller_id
  RETURNING s.id
),
latest_assignment AS (
  SELECT la.lead_id, la.seller_id, la.assignment_result
  FROM lead_assignments la
  JOIN input_payload ip ON ip.lead_id = la.lead_id
  ORDER BY la.created_at DESC, la.id DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
updated_lead AS (
  UPDATE leads l
  SET assigned_seller_id = COALESCE(la.seller_id, l.assigned_seller_id),
      assigned_at = CASE WHEN la.seller_id IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(l.assigned_at, NOW()) ELSE l.assigned_at END,
      lead_status_id = CASE WHEN la.seller_id IS NOT NULL THEN ls_assigned.id ELSE l.lead_status_id END,
      updated_at = NOW()
  FROM latest_assignment la
  LEFT JOIN lead_statuses ls_assigned ON ls_assigned.code = 'assigned'
  WHERE l.id = la.lead_id
  RETURNING l.*
)
SELECT
  l.id AS lead_id, l.phone_number, l.whatsapp_name, l.service, l.city, l.requirement,
  l.qualification_context, l.source_conversation_id AS conversation_id, wn.instance_name,
  COALESCE(ul.assigned_seller_id, l.assigned_seller_id) AS assigned_seller_id, s.name AS seller_name, s.whatsapp_number AS seller_whatsapp_number,
  s.clickup_user_id,
  CASE WHEN COALESCE(ul.assigned_seller_id, l.assigned_seller_id) IS NOT NULL THEN 'assigned' ELSE 'failed' END AS assignment_result
FROM leads l
JOIN input_payload ip ON ip.lead_id = l.id
LEFT JOIN whatsapp_numbers wn ON wn.id = l.source_number_id
LEFT JOIN updated_lead ul ON ul.id = l.id
LEFT JOIN updated_seller us ON TRUE
LEFT JOIN sellers s ON s.id = COALESCE(ul.assigned_seller_id, l.assigned_seller_id);
